abstract: Sanitized the LXC and VM guest instance metadata payloads, moved them to /root, and explicitly enforced mode 0600 without changing Proxmox module calls or readiness waits.
details: Each final writer now derives its serialized payload from the existing full homelabinfra_instance.lxc or .vm dictionary by applying dict2items, rejecting the shared denylist api_token_secret, api_token_id, password, pubkey, and sshkeys, restoring a dictionary with items2dict, and then applying to_nice_json. The existing full dictionaries, module-argument allowlists and calls, node delegation, and status/exec wait tasks are unchanged. Both writers now target /root/homelabinfra_instance.<guest>.json and execute umask 077 plus chmod 0600 in the guest command, including when the file already exists. Diff review satisfies AC1-AC3. The lint gate passed. The mandated test gate failed solely in unrelated repository playbooks because the docker role is unavailable, instance is undefined in two maintenance playbooks, and the rollback playbook is empty; its output contains no error for either modified file or the Proxmox create playbooks.
